ruledBy: Al, written by hand after rejecting all 30 of Astra's candidates for these photographs
note: Al supplied these by description, not by filename. Each photograph was opened and matched to his description before wiring; the mapping is recorded in `matchedOn`. Astra's 30 candidates for these photographs are dropped entirely — not held, not rejected, simply not used.

images.matchedOn: Cold image 1 — empty stoep: covered patio at dusk, blanket over the chair, steaming mug on the side table, shoes by the door
lines: Outside is closed. Management is inside.
Pretty evening. Deeply uninhabitable.

images.matchedOn: Cold image 2 — hands + hot drink, mountain, last light: gloved hand around a hot chocolate on a balcony, snow on the Apostles behind
lines: Beautiful view. Hostile air.
This is no longer a beverage. It's a strategy.

images.matchedOn: Cold image 3 — wet promenade, sunset, people + dog walking away
lines: Sunset showed up. The cold came with it.
The sky apologised. The pavement didn't.

images.matchedOn: Fog image 1 — forest road, figure walking into the white, dawn
lines: Visibility has clocked off. You're on your own.
Forward is still an option. Sightseeing is not.

images.matchedOn: Fog image 2 — harbour jetty, lights on, water and boats swallowed
lines: They turned the lights on. Fog turned everything else off.
Pretty evening, if you like walls.

images.matchedOn: Rain image 1 — doorway, wet garden, boots and jersey dumped inside
lines: Rain came all the way home.
It's proper rain. The day's over in stages.

images.matchedOn: Rain image 2 — harbour / wave: fishing harbour, wave breaking over the wall, two in raincoats watching
lines: Still raining. That's the whole update.
Wet between here and anywhere else.

images.matchedOn: Rain image 3 — Bo-Kaap: colourful houses, Lion's Head, man with an umbrella on wet cobbles
lines: Rain on an otherwise good-looking evening.
Wet out. The city can keep the colour.

images.matchedOn: Storm image 1 — people waiting under a shop canopy, lightning over a wet parking lot
lines: The sky is in charge now.
Not weather you walk through.
Storm. Plans can wait.
Outside is closed until further notice.

images.matchedOn: Storm image 2 — lightning over a stadium
lines: When the sky starts talking, everything else stops.
Serious weather. The rest is postponed.

images.matchedOn: Storm image 3 — quiet suburban street, dark storm sitting on the houses
lines: Get inside weather.
Stay in. That's the whole forecast.

images.matchedOn: Storm image 4 — open country road, rain shaft in the distance, chair in the road
lines: Storm with wind attached.
The storm has arrived. Everything else can wait.
Unsecured objects are now weather.

images.matchedOn: Storm image 5 — loading a bakkie against a huge storm cell
lines: Storm on the horizon. That's your deadline.
Finish up. The weather won't.
Storm's close. Home is closer, hopefully.

images.matchedOn: Storm image 6 — ceiling leak, bucket on the bed
lines: Rain was the warning. This is the follow-through.
Proper storm. Not the pretty kind.

images.matchedOn: "the guy in the doorway" — man standing in a lit gateway at dusk, umbrella down, a car passing in the wet street. Supplied 2026-09-06 after this photograph was flagged as the one bare rain frame he had not covered.
lines: Still raining. That's the update.
The rain didn't clock off.
